title: CAT Bond Pricing with Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks
abstract: arXiv:2608.19217v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the approximation of CAT bond prices under a compound Poisson loss model with lognormal severities using Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs). Building on a baseline-plus-residual learning pipeline, we train a KAN on the deviation from a closed-form lognormal baseline price and extract an interpretable symbolic pricing formula. The extracted formula achieves an average relative pricing error of 0.483% on a fully disjoint holdout sample of 90,000 simulated prices. In contrast to purely empirical modelling, we also analyse structural properties of the true CAT bond pricing map, including monotonicity with respect to the catastrophe arrival intensity lambda, the initial short rate r0, and the trigger threshold D. We derive sufficient conditions on KAN edge functions that guarantee these monotonicities are preserved by the learned model, and formulate a monotonicity-constrained training objective with a convergence guarantee. translated_title: 基于Kolmogorov--Arnold网络的巨灾债券定价
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们研究了在具有对数正态严重程度的复合泊松损失模型下，使用Kolmogorov--Arnold网络（KANs）近似巨灾债券价格的方法。基于基线加残差的学习流程，我们训练一个KAN来拟合相对于封闭形式对数正态基线价格的偏差，并提取出一个可解释的符号定价公式。该提取公式在90,000个模拟价格的完全独立留出样本上实现了平均相对定价误差0.483%。与纯经验建模不同，我们还分析了真实巨灾债券定价图的结构性质，包括对灾难到达强度lambda、初始短期利率r0和触发阈值D的单调性。我们推导了KAN边函数的充分条件，以保证这些单调性被学习模型保留，并制定了一个具有收敛保证的单调性约束训练目标。我们的结果...
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Kolmogorov--Arnold网络的可解释巨灾债券定价方法，通过提取符号公式并保证单调性，实现了极低的定价误差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an interpretable CAT bond pricing method using Kolmogorov--Arnold networks, extracting a symbolic formula with monotonicity guarantees and achieving very low pricing error.
